description: Move or rename a file or directory. Taking a file out of a zone with policy overwrite="rev" requires its current rev, exactly like overwriting it in place; directories are not moved out of a strict zone at all. Use trash_file, not this, to discard something; moving a file out of the trash restores it.

rev.description: Current rev of the source file, required when it leaves a zone with overwrite="rev".

name: move_file
title: Move or rename
